claims.claim: You must be a British national to get a UK passport.
claims.note: Being a British national is listed as a condition for a first adult passport.

claims.claim: British nationals for this purpose include British citizens, British overseas territory citizens and other categories.
claims.quote: Citizen of a British overseas territory and born before 1 January 1983
claims.note: The text implies citizens of a British overseas territory can apply, but it never lists which categories count as British national, so British citizens and the other unspecified categories are not set out.
